notes: Seventeen lists read. The Kids group had only three pains, so most entries had no cover; 11 candidates proposed, all with opened sources. oecd.org (including the Child Well-being Dashboard) and its cedefop mirror returned 403, so OECD entries come from the OECD slides mirrored on unstats.un.org. WHOQOL-BREF and Gallup's five elements have no item about children (adult instruments), so they have no entries here. The 211 national snapshot gives no child-specific need, only 'family support' (#5). The newest Pew school-shooting survey that would open is from 2018; the CDC YRBS 2023 figures back the same candidate. Pew's 2024 school-shooting page returned 403. Gallup MIP figures come from the Datawrapper table vEKjO on the page (latest column 26-Sep). Wikidata QIDs were found with the wbsearchentities API (rate-limited, retried; not counted as searches). Overlaps for refine: childcare-shortage vs childcare-costs (availability vs cost); kids-mental-health vs mental-health-crisis; child-poverty vs poverty; guns-and-kids vs crime-and-violence; kids-unsafe-online vs screens-and-kids; moms-and-babies may fit Health better than Kids; child-abuse vs unsafe-at-home (personal). child-abuse and kids-unsafe-online are tagged sensitive. Out of scope: child marriage, child labour, birth registration (global SDG targets no U.S. list names), road and drowning injuries, childhood infections.
